headlines.title: J.B. Hunt Comes Out Against Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern Merger
headlines.summary: The trucking company says the deal would do more harm than benefit, disputing the railroads' claim that it would lead to 2.1 million truck-to-rail conversions.

headlines.title: J.B. Hunt urges STB to reject Union Pacific–Norfolk Southern merger
headlines.summary: J.B. Hunt’s STB filing challenges projected truck-to-rail conversions and seeks enforceable protections if regulators approve the merger. The post J.B. Hunt urges STB to reject Union Pacific–Norfolk Southern merger appeared first on FreightWaves.

headlines.title: Rail Merger Risks Soaring Costs for Small Shippers

Eric Byer, CEO of the Alliance for Chemical Distribution, reveals how increased consolidation could cripple small, family-run businesses already battling limited competition, rising costs, and poor service. headlines.title: America's Biggest Manufacturers, Farmers, Railroads and Labor Unions Unite Against UP-NS Merger
headlines.summary: After reviewing Union Pacific's proposed $85 billion merger with Norfolk Southern, 57 additional parties formally opposed the transaction for the first time in last week's Surface Transportation Board (STB) comment round, including some of America's largest manufacturers, agricultural organizations and transportation companies.

headlines.title: Union Pacific Corporation Declares Fourth Quarter 2026 Dividend
headlines.summary: OMAHA, Neb., November 23, 2026--The Board of Directors of Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE: UNP) has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.42 per share on the company’s common stock, payable Dec. 30, 2026, to shareholders of record Dec. 4, 2026.

description: Union Pacific Corporation, through its subsidiary, Union Pacific Railroad Company, operates in the railroad business in the United States. It offers transportation services for grain and grain products, fertilizers, food and refrigerated products, and coal and renewables to grain processors, animal feeders, and ethanol and renewable biofuel producers; and construction products, industrial chemicals, plastics, forest products, specialized products, metals and ores, petroleum, liquid petroleum gases, soda ash, and sand, as well as finished automobiles, automotive parts, and merchandise in intermodal containers. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
